items.title: Geopolitical developments, crude prices likely to move markets this week

items.title: FPIs pour ₹16,621 crore into Indian equities in first half of August
items.description: The inflow follows a ₹20,200-crore investment in July, marking a sharp turnaround after four consecutive months of heavy selling by Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs)
